kill_switch.comment: OFF by default. Trie is a no-op until explicitly enabled. Drop-in replacement for RegistryWatchQueue.

trie_params.comment: 512 nodes support ~16 typical Windows registry paths (avg 32 chars each). 128-char alphabet covers ASCII.

benchmark_baseline.comment: Measured on Linux host. Trie is O(key_len) vs linear O(N x key_len). Speedup grows with N.

migration_guide.step_3: Replace queue.enqueue(ev) with trie_queue.enqueue(ev) (same return type: ?ht.SuspicionReason)
migration_guide.compatibility: 100% API-compatible drop-in replacement. Same defaults (6 persistence + 5 critical keys).
